description.en: A small enrolled Agnostus reconstruction with two free thoracic segments and nine appendage pairs. It represents the first holaspid stage; missing shield edges and limbs are conservatively restored, fine setae simplified and colour unknown.
description.zh: 小型卷曲Agnostus复原，具有两枚游离胸节和九对附肢，表现首个holaspid阶段。缺失盾缘与附肢保守补配，细刚毛简化，活体颜色未知。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete first holaspid living reconstruction with matching rounded cephalic and pygidial shields, exactly two liberated thoracic tergites and nine appendage pairs; moderately gaping enrolled posture rather than a featureless closed shell.

scientific_limits.en: UB822 is the actual first-holaspid anatomical anchor, with published cephalic shield840x820micrometers and partial ventral preservation. Missing border and appendages are reconstructed from same-species h1 reconstruction and adjacent late-meraspid anatomy, not claimed preserved on UB822. Two free thoracic tergites are genuine h1 morphology, not one-segment meraspis. Body total if unfolded about1.8mm is an estimate; modeled gaping span differs. Appendage microsetae simplified, coloration unknown.
scientific_limits.zh: 实际主锚UB822为首个holaspid，论文头盾840×820微米，腹面仅部分保存。缺失盾缘及附肢按同种h1复原和相邻晚meraspid阶段保守补配，不称UB822全部保存。两枚游离胸节是h1真实形态，不以一胸节幼体替代。若展开全长约1.8毫米仅估计，张口卷曲姿态包围尺寸不同。细微刚毛简化，活体颜色未知。

scale.uncertainty: Published UB822shield measurements anchor micro-scale. Totalestimate is not directspecimenlength; use camera fitting, never multiply geometry scale tolooklarger.

anatomy: Broad near-round cephalic shield with smooth fields, modest axial glabellar lobation and narrow rim; no large dorsal compound eyes. Tiny uncertain ventral frontal organs must not become eyes on stalks.

Pygidium almost matching headshape andsize, axial raised area and short paired marginal spines. Two separate narrow articulating thoracic tergites link shields; count only free tergites, not pygidial fused subdivisions.

Moderately gaping enrolled posture based on Fig16B-C, about60degrees opening allows limbs and hinge to remain visible. Not a bivalve with lateralhinge and not flattened fully outstretched contrary to enrollment anatomy.

Four cephalic appendage pairs total: I sigmoidal antennules, II strong multisegmented setose exopod with absent/reduced endopod, III biramous with segmented endopod andstrong exopod, IV smaller biramous leg with club-like endopodalpart.
Five trunk appendage pairs decrease posteriorly, with lastone developed smallleg inh1 rather than meraspidbud. Anterior trunklegs biramous; keep compactundershields, no enormous spiderlegs.
Setae represented by limited broadreadable filaments rather than individual microscopic hairs. Anatomical left-right pairs, no moderncrustacean accessory claw orlongtail.
Muted matte warm-gray shell and softunderside are artistic, not originalcolor evidence.
restoration_boundaries: Plate5allimages are UB822 actual SEM; shield edge partlyremoved andfrontbroken. Fig2 is author h1reconstruction, notadditionalphotograph.
Fig6 late-meraspid appendages are used only as declared neighboring-stage anatomical supplement; text states small changes toh1 andninepairs inh1. Lasttrunklimb h1 is developed beyondbud.
Do not use stage1bphoto from2009 as two-thoracic main specimen. Do not claim UB87fromanothercrustaceanpaper as Agnostus.
No rigid fullunrolling toshowalllimbs; gapingposture preserves completeanimal anddistincttwojointedtergites.
